The '''Mon Calamari Ballet''' was a prestigious aquatic dance troupe made up of members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed<ref name="CSWE Ballet" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> they performed<ref name="CSWE Ballet" /> the Mon Calamari ballet<ref name="Squid Lake CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|185|Squid Lake}}</ref> [[Squid Lake/Legends|''Squid Lake'']] in the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] in<ref name="Screenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]]<ref name="Screenplay" /> [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> The show, ''Squid Lake''{{'s}} Coruscant premiere,<ref name="Squid Lake CSWE" /> was a modern performance of a classic ballet.<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] attended their 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] performance<ref name="CSWE Ballet" /> alongside others. In that performance, members of the Ballet wore a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Clothing/Legends|bodysuit]] and a pink and yellow ribbon connected to their heads<ref name="SWCTP" /> as they danced between the zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] spheres of [[Water/Legends|water]] that defined ''Squid Lake''.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We'd seen Admiral Ackbar, who's older, so this is a pass at what a younger Mon Calamari dancer might look like&mdash;one who'd been working out nearly every waking moment.|Aaron McBride, on designing the ballet dancers|<ref name="Art of ROTS">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
The Mon Calamari Ballet were first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']],<ref name="Screenplay" /> released on [[April 2]], [[2005]]<ref name="Screenplay date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20050308.html|text=Episode III eBooks On Their Way}}</ref> ahead of their appearance in the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> on [[May 19]] of the same year.<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The performers of the ballet were named "Mon Calamari dancers" by producer [[Rick McCallum]], and concept art for the ballet dancers was created by [[Aaron McBride]], art director at [[Industrial Light & Magic]]. McBride modeled them off of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]],<ref name="Art of ROTS" /> who had marked the first live-action appearance of Mon Calamari in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> but designed them to be younger and more muscular as befitting the members of a dance troupe.<ref name="Art of ROTS" />
